svg.title: Echo
svg.desc: Off-grid encrypted communication. Offline Android messaging for emergency and disaster relief: BLE mesh, independent direct messages, compressed media, and cached delivery. Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Coroutines, X25519, AES-256-GCM, and local identity.
